tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List the commits to a GitHub repository since a time, newest first, optionally only those on a branch or that touch a path. Returns each commit's SHA, message, author, date and link.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

path.description: Only commits that touch this file or directory, for example deploy/values.yaml.

ref.description: The branch, tag or SHA to list from. Default: the default branch.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

since.description: Only commits made at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

until.description: Only commits made before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get one commit of a GitHub repository: its message, author, date, parents, the files it changed with line counts, and the patch of each file, cut when the commit is large.

ref.description: The commit SHA, or a branch or tag to get its latest commit.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List the pull requests of a GitHub repository that were opened or merged since a time, most recently updated first, with their state, branches, author, times, merge commit and link.

base.description: Only pull requests into this branch, for example main.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

since.description: Only pull requests opened or merged at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List the releases of a GitHub repository, newest first, with tag, name, dates and link. With includeTags, also list the newest tags and the commit each points at; tags have no dates.

includeTags.description: Also list the newest tags. Default false.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

since.description: Only releases made at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List the GitHub Actions workflow runs of a repository, newest first, for example deploys: workflow, status, conclusion, event, branch, commit, times and link.

event.description: Only runs started by this event, such as push, workflow_dispatch or release.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

since.description: Only runs created at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

status.description: Only runs with this status or conclusion.

workflow.description: Only runs of this workflow: its file name, such as deploy.yml, or its numeric ID.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Read a file of a GitHub repository at a ref, or list a directory. Files over 256 KiB are cut, and binary files are not shown.

path.description: The file or directory, relative to the repository root, for example deploy/values.yaml.

ref.description: The branch, tag or commit SHA to read at. Default: the default branch.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two refs of a GitHub repository, base...head: how far head is ahead of and behind base, the newest commits between them, and the files changed with line counts.

base.description: The older branch, tag or SHA, for example the tag of the last good release.

head.description: The newer branch, tag or SHA.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/checkout. Give repo or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its repository in its own settings. Give repo or service, not both.
